## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-5-5`, cutoff 2026-06-30) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [guide] = the package's upgrade guide, [summary] = summary of both.

**typescript** 6.0.3 → 7.0.2 (major)
- `CompilerOptions` options removed: `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` (this project sets it); also `alwaysStrict`, `baseUrl`, `charset`, `downlevelIteration`, `importsNotUsedAsValues`, `keyofStringsOnly`, `noStrictGenericChecks`, `noImplicitUseStrict` (+6 more). [types]
  Before: `const options: ts.CompilerOptions = { allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true };` → After: `export const compilerOptions = { strict: true }; // allowSyntheticDefaultImports removed` (type-checked)
- `CompilerOptions` moved to `typescript/unstable/sync` [types]

**react** 19.2.6 → 19.3.1
- Render errors are no longer re-thrown in React 19: uncaught errors go to `window.reportError` and errors caught by an Error Boundary go to `console.error`. If your error reporting relied on re-throwing, pass `onUncaughtError` and `onCaughtError` to `createRoot`/`hydrateRoot` instead. [guide]
- `propTypes` checks are removed from React 19 and are silently ignored, so they no longer warn. Use TypeScript types instead. [guide]
- `defaultProps` no longer applies to function components in React 19. Use ES6 default parameters (`function Heading({text = 'Hello'})`) instead. Class components still support `defaultProps`. [guide]
- `ref` is now a regular prop: read it with `element.props.ref`, not `element.ref`, which is deprecated and warns. Function components can accept `ref` as a prop directly. [guide]
- A function returned from a ref callback is now treated as a cleanup function. Don't implicitly return values from ref callbacks: write `ref={el => {instance = el}}`, not `ref={el => (instance = el)}`. [guide]
- `act` moved from `react-dom/test-utils` to `react`, so write `import {act} from 'react'`. All other `react-dom/test-utils` functions are removed and error when called. [guide]
- Transitions now render independently instead of being entangled into a single render, so a slow transition no longer holds up unrelated ones (@acdlite ) [changelog]
